Early test builds of Bass: Submix (A16) are on the Bass OS website: https://bassos.navotpala.tech/#downloads

As well as SourceForge for now:
https://sourceforge.net/projects/bliss-co-labs/files/BlissBass/Bass-Submix/

It's such a wide departure from the normal Android-x86 or Waydroid type setup that it should really have its own category.
